issues.pattern: Docker image referenced without tag or digest: 'docker run -e`'.
issues.explanation: Docker image references without a specific tag (:latest is implicit) or digest (@sha256:...) can be silently replaced by a malicious image.
issues.remediation: Pin the image: image:tag or image@sha256:abc123

issues.explanation: Commands invoke sudo or root privileges. Verify this elevated access is necessary and justified.
issues.remediation: Avoid sudo/root unless strictly required. Prefer least-privilege patterns. If elevation is needed, document the justification and scope.
